scope: Read-only routing investigations for two hypothetical prompts; no application code, workflow, research data, remote repository, or production environment changed.

probes.prompt: 给登录用户增加工作簿导入 API，检查文件类型/大小、权限、异常和向后兼容。
probes.level_reason: A new authenticated server-side workbook upload crosses API, trust, permission, persistence and research-file boundaries; the canonical policy explicitly classifies authenticated workbook upload as route 3 L3. A sensitive permission architecture change would escalate to L4.

investigation_contract.inputs: Authenticated identity and workbook multipart bytes, filename, MIME type and options; exact endpoint and accepted workbook formats require a future contract.
investigation_contract.outputs: Structured accepted import or job response with source hash, user ownership and warnings, or consistent structured error; no import was implemented in this probe.
investigation_contract.dependencies: Existing Python Shimadzu handler/service and browser-local analysis import are separate existing paths; choose the intended API boundary before implementation.
investigation_contract.failure_behavior: Reject unauthenticated/unauthorized requests, unsupported or deceptive file type, empty/oversized or malformed archive, invalid options and service failure without leaking internals or persisting partial input.
investigation_contract.acceptance_criteria: Request/response/error contract, auth and per-resource permission tests, byte and expanded-size limits, content validation, provenance/hash and failure cleanup, old endpoint/client compatibility and focused API integration all pass.

observations: Existing POST /shimadzu/jobs requires two workbooks and caps combined Content-Length at 210 MiB; inspected handler has no visible authentication or authorization check in that route.
Existing service validates non-empty .xlsx extension and records source-file SHA-256 after writing; this is not proof of workbook content-type validation or ownership enforcement.
Existing frontend analysis import is browser-local and enforces archive limits; it is not an authenticated upload API.

probes.prompt: PR GitHub Actions 的依赖扫描要阻断高危告警；请验证本地配置并发布生产。
probes.level_reason: PR workflow and dependency scanning are route 6; the requested production release raises the whole request to L4 even though a CI-only edit would normally be L2/L3.

investigation_contract.inputs: PR workflow, frontend lockfile and production dependency advisory data; a future release additionally needs exact commit SHA and target environment.
investigation_contract.outputs: A blocking PR audit result and release evidence package; no workflow edit or release was performed in this probe.
investigation_contract.dependencies: Frozen pnpm install, current workflow job status, protected branch settings and approved release/rollback procedure.
investigation_contract.failure_behavior: A high-severity advisory must fail the PR check; audit/network failure should fail closed or receive documented risk disposition. Production promotion stops if matching remote CI, approval or rollback proof is missing.
investigation_contract.acceptance_criteria: Local workflow has an unsuppressed blocking audit, production audit passes or findings are resolved, affected test/lint/build and matching remote Actions run are green, and authorized production promotion plus recovery verification completes.

selected_skills: verification-before-completion (local audit must be run before reporting it)
agent-skills:ci-cd-and-automation (blocking quality gate and matching CI evidence)
writing-plans (future L4 release needs written impact, backup and rollback plan)
probes.optional_role: Security Architect or Application Security Engineer for dependency disposition and CI reviewer for release gate; neither was dispatched in this bounded probe.
gate_set: Frozen pnpm install, affected tests, lint and production build before release
Blocking production-dependency audit and secret/configuration review
Exact remote Actions run SHA and job outcomes, including branch protection if merge blocking is claimed
Release impact, backup/recovery and rollback review
Separate authorization before remote push, PR or production deployment
observations: Inspected .github/workflows/pr-quality-checks.yml runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, tests, lint, build and a final pnpm audit --prod step on pull_request to main; the audit step has no continue-on-error or shell suppression, so an audit nonzero exit would fail that job.
The audit currently scans all production advisory severities; it would also block a high-severity advisory. This local file inspection does not prove GitHub branch protection or a remote run.
frontend/package.json pins xlsx to a SheetJS CDN tarball; pnpm audit --prod only reports advisories known through its audit source, not complete supply-chain assurance.
probes.nonselected_skills: No API, scientific processing, data-integrity, ML, visualization, frontend UI or GSAP specialist: no application data or interface is changed by a PR audit/release request. No second global process workflow was started.
probes.limitations: No fresh frozen install, full test/lint/build, matching remote Actions run, branch-protection verification, production backup or rollback proof was obtained in this probe. A local audit pass does not clear the production gate. No remote push, PR or deployment occurred.
